text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "Paragraph divisions and introductory/concluding transitions like \"For example\" and \"And that is why\"", "quality": "Structural Organization", "description": "This captures the degree to which an essay uses logical paragraphing and transitions to create a clear macro-structure."}, {"evidence": "Correct sentence boundaries instead of continuous run-on structures linked by \"and\"", "quality": "Sentence Boundary Control", "description": "This measures the writer's ability to demarcate discrete sentences using appropriate punctuation rather than stringing clauses together endlessly."}, {"evidence": "Varied vocabulary choices such as \"investigating,\" \"evidence,\" \"homicide,\" and \"tactics\"", "quality": "Lexical Diversity", "description": "This reflects the writer's use of specific, varied, and precise vocabulary rather than vague, repetitive filler words."}, {"evidence": "Clear attempt to present a central thesis and develop distinct supporting points across paragraphs", "quality": "Coherent Paragraph Development", "description": "This captures how effectively a writer establishes a main idea and expands upon it through focused, supporting paragraphs."}]}
